newsitem.title: FRANCE: France sells 1.98 bln Ffr BTANs at auction.
newsitem.headline: France sells 1.98 bln Ffr BTANs at auction.

text.p: The Treasury said on Friday it sold a further 1.98 billion francs of BTANs after Thursday's auction, increasing the total value of bonds sold to 20.565 billion.

NOTE - The Treasury originally announced it would sell 17 to 19 billion francs of BTANs in total today. The total bid cover ratio of the auction was 2.3.

Under the French system, primary dealers and central banks not only submit competitive bids at the auction, but also have the option, for a limited period after the sale, of buying extra bonds at the average auction price.
